_comment: Fine topology-optimisation runs. Load model: the 20 N design force on each wheel (car stationary or racing) as a radial press at the contact, applied at every position the wheel can roll into - every ~5 deg across one symmetry sector in the optimiser (n_phi per sector) and every 1 deg in the final check - plus 20 000 rpm spin and the 1 N running stiffness in the check. No pinch, edge or axial loads. Objective: minimum rotational inertia of the wheel body (bearings excluded); constraint: von Mises <= sigma_target (default 0.9 x UTS/2). Each entry: Setup parameters for analysis/topo.py plus t_min (minimum wall, enforced on the output geometry), verify_h (tet size of the full-accuracy check) and verify_step_deg. Earlier press + pinch runs (r01-r07) are recorded in README.md and on the fine-run-results branch.

runs.name: r08_N5_press_skin0.6
runs.note: SLS PA12, 0.6 mm skin and min wall, 5-fold symmetry, radial press only (rolling every ~5 deg); rf 1.5 (2.5 x min wall) so the optimiser itself keeps members >= 0.6 mm instead of the min-wall rule adding ~0.25 g after the fact (r01b/r03/r04 at rf 1.2)
